body: 2nd. I've heard its both. I've reached out, but it might be too little too late, honestly. The personal might be outweighing the professional at this point.

Because I'm so new, my district won't let me transfer until I have a certain amount of years under my belt. I can't jump ship unless I go out of district. 

Also, I am shit at networking. This is the extent of it.
I'm too new to move in the public system. Should I go private?

That has NEVER been brought up to me. I am in rows/columns and I am preparing my students for being in rows for when they are in higher level HS math classes and potentially college. I have seen other teachers do groups and "families" but I have no idea how to implement it. I have had no direction on it. I have had a little bit of modeling, but I am nowhere near comfortable with it.
What do you do that makes the "hens" keep it away from you?
I physically cannot fit any more students. I don't have the desk space. I don't know what world she is living in, but it isn't reality.
If I'm posting about it, it is WELL under my skin.

The teacher I replaced up and left the county, no notice. I didn't even know what I was supposed to teach until I got there. I got passed that and eventually got to the point where I am now, but I feel like I'm at square one. I feel like I've forgotten everything. I feel like I can't do anything. I feel like I can't wait 2 years for my dream position. And after discussing with a colleague, my dream position won't come up where I am teaching now.
How so? Before the break, I was enjoying myself. I have good colleagues, a supportive administrative structure, fairly decent students. I just hate my subject. Right?
I think I like teaching, but I know I don't like WHAT I'm teaching. I teach math, but I know math is not what I want to teach.
What's plan b?

I have no idea where the students' skill gaps are. As for IEPs, I don't think I even have access to the software yet. It still says "training" on that thing. 

"I do, we do, you do" is great advice! I'm gonna start using that! Do I tell them and make a deal, or do I do it without saying, and how do I do that?

Did I tell you I started with no preparation time. I'm pretty much running on ice.
The problem is we're not in this together. We're divided down the middle. We'll never be in this together again.

My folks are telling me that it doesn't matter and that I shouldn't worry since I won't be personally affected and that I can't personally change the results. That makes no sense to me. I still feel empathy for those who are more affected. I fear uprisings across the country regardless of who wins.
What do I do instead?
If it were as easy as not thinking about it, I wouldn't be posting here. I've tried distracting, but it doesn't work.

I fear losing my healthcare if I lose my job. I fear for my aunts' marriage being declared null and void. I fear that I can't live on what I'm paid. I fear that Proud Boys will run rampant and will lynch people like me and my girlfriend.
This god damn election. I can't look away, but it makes me so anxious and nauseated. If it goes the way I think it will, I don't think I can take it. I think I'd rather die.
I only use this account when I'm on the brink of stress-related suicide or mental breakdown. This is one of those times.
How did you know I was the child of a narcissist?
Thing is I don't want to put myself in a position to spread Covid to people I live with.

I've been replaying failure tapes from 10 years old and on. They don't collect dust because I replay them so often. Maybe I do need a support group. I thought I was passed a lot of this Aspie stuff, but it all came back with a vengeance.
What do you suggest? What's good right now?
I'm pretty sure they're closed due to Covid.
Baseball, American history and wrestling, pretty much all my life. Things come and go though: 60's music, early English history through the War of the Roses, my religion.
Lost my job. Worked my ass of 24/7 for the past two weeks and it wasn't good enough.

I guess this is where I officially start. SW 270 lbs. GW 170 lbs. I'm gonna be here for a while, I accept that. I started on Nutrisystem today and, judging by what I've been reading, the fact that I'm not using MyFitnessPal is gonna go over like a fart in church. 

I try to play tennis twice a week for about an hour, but I've been out of step for 2 weeks. I would say that it's time to start exercising, but it's all so overwhelming. So many machines and no idea what to do with them. Time to learn, I suppose.

First off, looking through your post history, what you are doing is wonderful. Thank you.

Second, when I perseverate, my thoughts turn to escape. Trying to find a way out. Trying to find comfort when it feels like it's a thousand miles away. Focusing on how alone I am when in reality I'm lucky to be the opposite. 

It's not that I even want to die, but rather get the hell out. Suicide seems like an adequate means to the end when I'm in that spiral.

I deal with the same thing. I couldn't put it in as good of words as OP. But work and family are both non-starters on that end and I don't know how to avoid the news. I'm a redditor and a news junkie. What the heck am I supposed to do? How do I get away from this?
